title: Why Earnings Growth Remain a Key Buffer Against Yield Risks
summary: Capital.com Senior Market Analyst Kyle Rodda argues that strong corporate earnings continue to buffer equities against rising bond yields and AI valuation risks. He also cautions that investor tolerance could fade quickly if profit growth expectations begin to fade. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Gold Trades Near Seven-Week Low as Rate-Hike Pressure Mounts
summary: Gold held a sharp decline as the deadlock between the US and Iran over the Strait of Hormuz continued to keep energy costs elevated and maintained pressure on the Federal Reserve to hike interest rates.

title: Treasuries Stabilize After Selloff, Stocks Slip: Markets Wrap
summary: A Treasury selloff stabilized in early Asian trading after elevated oil prices stemming from the US-Iran standoff and bets on further Federal Reserve interest-rate hikes pushed yields to multi-year highs.

title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Sept. 29
summary: Oil rose for a second day as a lack of progress in US-Iran talks and signs of strong demand outweighed a resumption of flows through a key pipeline from top exporter Saudi Arabia.
